gepa_selected.instruction: Carefully analyze the text to identify the primary emotion expressed, prioritizing contextual and tonal cues over incidental details, and output the corresponding capital letter from the label mapping.

interpretation: GEPA-selected and post-hoc-audit-best are reported separately. The post-hoc audit is exploratory and does not retroactively change GEPA acceptance.

posthoc_audit_best.instruction: Carefully analyze the text to identify the primary emotion expressed, considering context and tone, and select the corresponding capital letter from the label mapping, while prioritizing the dominant emotion over incidental keywords.

seed.instruction: Carefully determine the main emotion the writer expresses from the label mapping, ignore incidental details, and output only the corresponding capital letter.
